claims.statement: In the ratio-variance packet normal form with invertible indefinite scalar pair B, D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), packet mass m and mu=D|lambda|, ||p_Q||inf <= 8*2^(3/4)*sqrt(5)*(mu*kappa*m)^(-1/4), independent of the ratio residual sigma.
For exact B=[[0,c],[c,0]] and residual cross-row norm eta_R, ||p_Q||inf <14.7240 [mu*m*(eta_R/|c|)^2]^(-1/3); thus the exact-double-zero endpoint is kappa-free when eta_R/|c| is bounded below.

newest_volume_application.actual_inequality: a=1/4 near-diffuse certificate implies a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf<92

first_unpaid_summary: No positive-mass exact slope atom; kappa tends to zero; at exact double-zero eta_R/kappa tends to zero; no a=1/4 near-diffuse volume certificate. Near-doublezero diagonal terms must be retained exactly.
